lead: Everything a person wears on the body except shoes, jewellery, bags and eyewear, organised by garment type (tops, bottoms, dresses, coats, suits, underwear, headwear, traditional dress, workwear), with iconic patterns as archetypes and brands, traditions and scenes held in registers.

b.v: fibre content · weight (gsm/oz) · hand · resistance to pilling and loss of shape
b.w: First quality marker for all clothing; owner proposal.

b.v: seams, stitching, hems; zips and buttons; linings

b.w: Owner proposal: durable, versatile design and maker transparency/repair.

b.v: original pattern > licensed/contract maker > faithful reproduction > interpretation
b.w: Archetype standard: the same ladder is used for versions of every icon.

depts.note: Tier for basics, variety for named icons (polos, knitwear, sweats).

b.v: yarn (cotton, merino, cashmere, Shetland) · gauge · fully fashioned vs cut-and-sew
b.w: Main differentiator for sweaters and polos.

s.brief: Archetype standard. T-shirt: archetypes Hanes Beefy-T, Champion T1011, Sunspel Riviera, Supreme Box Logo tee; types crew/V/Henley/baseball/long-sleeve/pocket/tall; drop wholesale blanks (Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Next Level, AS Colour, Comfort Colors SKUs) and Saint James models (to Breton shirt). Polo: archetypes Lacoste L.12.12 (1933), Fred Perry M12 twin-tipped (1952) and M3, Ralph Lauren Polo (1972), Sunspel Riviera, John Smedley knit polo, Munsingwear Grand Slam; move rugby shirt models to Rugby shirt. Tank: A-shirt/Chesty Bond, Lululemon Align; trim. Team jersey: tier, kind-level with types (home/away/retro/replica), no title lists. Corset top: cut Disturbia SKU list to 1–2; types overbust/underbust/bustier. Bodysuit: adult only; baby onesie goes to Baby bodysuit.

k.brief: Canterbury of NZ, Barbarian, J.Crew Rugby, Ralph Lauren Rugby; types long-sleeve/hooped.
Marinière: Saint James Meridien/Minquiers (1889 house), Armor Lux, Orcival, Le Minor, Petit Bateau; link Nautical tradition entry.
Onesie/babygrow; tag baby; Gerber Onesies archetype; tier (Which?/CR).

s.brief: Button-up shirt: archetypes Brooks Brothers OCBD (1896), Ben Sherman button-down, Pendleton Board Shirt (1924), Kamakura Vintage Ivy, Seditionaries Anarchy shirt; types oxford/flannel/chambray/linen/camp collar/CPO. Move aloha, guayabera, kebaya, tibuta, Western, barong, dashiki, vyshyvanka, huipil, Madiba shirt to their own kinds or traditional shelves. Dress shirt: Turnbull & Asser, Charvet, Hilditch & Key, Charles Tyrwhitt Non-Iron, Uniqlo Super Non-Iron; types collar (spread, cutaway, pin, wing) · cuff (barrel, French). Overshirt: cut Barbour SKU flood to 2–3; archetypes CPO shirt, Swanndri bush shirt. Blouse: types pussy-bow, Peter Pan, peasant, smock.

k.brief: Reyn Spooner (Spooner Kloth, reverse print), Kahala (1936), Sun Surf repros, Sig Zane, Tori Richard; types rayon/cotton · pullover; link to Surf scene.
Rockmount Ranch Wear snap shirt (1946, Jack A. Weil), H Bar C Denver shirt, Wrangler, Levi's sawtooth; types yoke, pearl snaps, smile pockets.

s.brief: Split heritage knits out of Sweater into their own kinds with tradition entries (Aran, Shetland/Fair Isle, Guernsey/gansey, Lopapeysa, Norwegian, Cowichan). Sweater keeps general types (crew, V, turtleneck/rollneck, shawl collar, cricket) and archetypes J.Press Shaggy Dog, Sonia Rykiel Poor Boy, Ralph Lauren Flag sweater, John Smedley. Cardigan: archetypes Cowichan-type zip cardigan (move Cowichan to its kind), Pendleton Westerley, Thom Browne 4-Bar, letterman cardigan; trim Barbour/Aubin lists to 1–2. Sweater vest: tier.

k.brief: Aran Islands tradition (early 20th c.); Inis Meáin, Aran Sweater Market, Carraig Donn, Inverallan; stitch types cable/honeycomb/diamond.
Le Tricoteur, Guernsey Woollens, Flamborough Marine; link Nautical tradition.
Shetland tradition; Jamieson's of Shetland, Mati Ventrillon, Harley of Scotland; versions: Prince of Wales 1921.
Icelandic yoke sweater (1950s); Handknitting Association of Iceland, Farmers Market, Icewear, Guðrun & Guðrun Vón.
Marius (Unn Søiland Dale 1953, Rauma), Setesdal (Rauma, Dale of Norway Cortina), Fana; Devold, Oleana.
Coast Salish tradition; Kanata, Granted; authenticity markers (hand-spun, undyed wool).

s.brief: Hoodie archetypes: Champion Reverse Weave (1938), Supreme Box Logo (1994), BAPE Shark hoodie, Russell Athletic; types pullover/zip · weight gsm. Sweatshirt: Reverse Weave crew, Camber, Loopwheel (Japan: Loopwheeler, Buzz Rickson's), Vollebak as leftover. Drop Carhartt FR work SKUs.

depts.note: Jeans are a full hobbyist kind; the rest tier.

b.v: loom (shuttle selvedge > projectile) · weight oz · mill (Cone, Kaihara, Kuroki, Collect, Candiani) · sanforized vs unsanforized · yarn (slub, neppy)

s.brief: One kind, archetype-led: Levi's 501 (1873/1890) with versions LVC 1947/1955/1966, Big E, modern; 505 (1967), 517 bootcut, 511; Lee 101Z Riders (1926) and Lee 101J jacket stays in Trucker; Wrangler 13MWZ (1947); A.P.C. Petit Standard; Nudie; Evisu Lot 2000; JNCO wide-leg (1985) as one archetype with its models as versions; Japanese repro houses (Warehouse 1001XX, Sugar Cane 1947, Full Count 1101, TCB 50s, Momotaro, Iron Heart 634, Samurai S710XX, Studio D'Artisan SD-101, Flat Head 3005, Pure Blue Japan) as versions of 501/505 patterns or as their own house cuts; types fit (straight, slim, tapered, wide, bootcut, flare) · rise · wash. Cut Levi's modern SKU list to the named fits above; drop Carrera, Gas, Cecil, Mavi, Castro noise.

Trousers: fold Culottes in as a type; types pleated/flat front, wide, tapered, cropped; archetypes Levi's Sta-Prest (1964), DAKS self-supporting trouser (1934), Incotex, Bernard Zins; drop Greiff/Horace Small uniform ranges. Chinos: archetype US Army khaki/officer's chino, Dockers Original (1986), Bills Khakis, Bonobos (trim to 1). Cargo: archetype M-51/BDU trousers, Carhartt (trim), Craghoppers Kiwi. Joggers: Nike Tech Fleece (2013), Champion, Russell; tracksuit bottoms link to Tracksuit kind. Shorts: archetypes Patagonia Baggies (1982), Stubbies, Birdwell (to Swim trunks), Dolphin shorts, Bermuda; types cargo/chino/jorts/running. Leggings: Lululemon Align (2015), American Apparel Disco Pant, Uniqlo Heattech; move latex models to Corset/fetish note. Bondage trousers: archetype Seditionaries/Westwood–McLaren (1976), versions Tripp NYC, Boy London.

depts.note: Dresses organised by silhouette, each with its originating icon.

s.brief: Replace the 80-product Dress list with silhouette kinds. Redistribute existing models: DvF to Wrap dress; Halston 704 to Shirt dress; Mary Quant Georgie, YSL Mondrian and Trapeze to Shift & A-line; Collectif/Bettie Page/Pinup Girl swing dresses to Fit-and-flare; Pinup wiggle to Sheath; Bazza Alzouman gown, Schiaparelli Lobster, Versace safety-pin to Evening gown; Batsheva and Thea Porter to Babydoll & smock / Maxi; Atsuko Kudo and BustedBrand latex to Sheath with a fetish note (trim to 2); traditional names (qipao, karakou, habesha kemis, kaftan, ohorokova, Kabyle, robe Naïli, şemlek) to Traditional dress shelves. Pinafore: Lolita JSK archetypes (Angelic Pretty, BTSSB, Innocent World, Victorian Maiden) and dungaree dress type.

k.brief: Archetype DvF wrap dress (1974); Charles James 'Taxi' dress (1932) as forerunner; versions by reference name.
Halston Ultrasuede 704 (1972), Claire McCardell shirtwaist, Burberry trench dress.
Calvin Klein 1990s, John Galliano bias slip; types bias-cut, lace-trimmed.
Mary Quant minidress (1960s), YSL Trapeze (1958) and Mondrian (1965), Courrèges, Givenchy/Hubert LBD 1961 as sheath or shift per source.
Little black dress (Chanel 1926) as archetype; Hervé Léger bandage dress (1989); Azzedine Alaïa; wiggle/pencil dress; bodikon note.
Dior New Look (1947) origin; circle/swing dress (Collectif, Hell Bunny, Unique Vintage); skater dress.
Thea Porter gipsy/Faye dresses, Ossie Clark, Laura Ashley/Gunne Sax prairie, modern maxi; kaftan dress cross-link to Kaftan.

Ball gown, mermaid, column; Schiaparelli Lobster (1937), Versace safety-pin (1994), Bazza Alzouman balloon-sleeve gown; bridal gown as type (ball gown, mermaid, A-line, sheath) with bridal houses in register.
1940s tea dress, 1950s sundress (halter, strappy), Reformation, Dôen; types.
Babydoll (1950s, Kinderwhore revival), Batsheva Smock/Lillian/Snap, Molly Goddard tulle; Peter Pan collar type.

s.brief: Skirt: types mini, midi, maxi, pencil, pleated, circle, wrap, skort, tennis; archetypes Mary Quant miniskirt (1960s), Vivienne Westwood Mini-Crini (1985), rah-rah; move kilt, pollera, mamianqun, dirndl skirt to Traditional shelves. Jumpsuit: boiler-style (Elizabeth Suzann Clyde, Bridge & Burn Utility), catsuit as type (move latex catsuits here from Atsuko Kudo/BustedBrand, trim), playsuit/romper type. Tracksuit: archetypes adidas Beckenbauer (1967) and Firebird, Juicy Couture velour (2001), Sergio Tacchini, Fila, shell suit (1980s). Co-ord set: general matching sets (short set, skirt set). Costume: fancy dress sets; types; Morphsuit archetype; kept kind-level.

depts.note: Archetype-led; the richest icon area in Clothing.

b.v: fill power first, then fill weight; down vs synthetic
Gore-Tex, Pertex, X-PAC, waxed cotton, Ventile, Melton wool
b.w: Owner proposal for technical outerwear; Ventile/waxed cotton added for heritage shells.

b.v: horsehide > steerhide > cowhide > goatskin > lambskin; full-grain vs corrected

s.brief: Overcoat: archetypes Crombie coat, Covert coat (Cordings), Chesterfield, Polo coat (Brooks/Polo RL), Max Mara 101801 and Manuela, Loden coat; types single/double breasted. Trench: Burberry Tielocken→Kensington/Chelsea/Waterloo (1912), Aquascutum, Mackintosh, Sanyo 100-Year coat; drop Acronym J1L-GT (to Shell). Pea coat: US Navy pea coat archetype with Schott 740/140, Sterlingwear, Dalmard Marine, Gloverall versions; bridge coat type. Duffle: Gloverall Monty (1951), Original Montgomery; toggle types. Parka: M-51 fishtail (1951) with Mod revival versions (Alpha, Buzz Rickson's), N-3B (Alpha), Canada Goose Expedition (1982), TNF McMurdo, Snorkel parka; cut Canada Goose list to Expedition/Chilliwack/Langford. Puffer coat: Norma Kamali Sleeping Bag Coat (1973), Uniqlo Seamless Down, Moncler long; tier brands (Which?/CR winners). Raincoat: Mackintosh (1823 Charles Macintosh) rubberised mac, Hunter hunting coat, Stutterheim; types. Fur coat: types pelts (mink, fox, shearling); faux fur; Shuba; Yves Salomon, Saga Furs stub. Cape: Carla Fernández, Basotho blanket (Seana Marena, Aranda), bisht, bernous as types with traditions; Max Mara cape.

Unify MA-1 into Flight jacket as one archetype among A-2 (1931), G-1 (1947), B-3 (1934), B-6, B-10, B-15 (1944), MA-1 (1949), CWU-45/P (1972), N-2B; each with versions: original contractors (Aero Leather, Rough Wear, Dobbs, Alpha Industries as contractor), reproductions (Buzz Rickson's, The Real McCoy's, Eastman, Aero Leather Clothing, Cockpit USA/Avirex, Toys McCoy), interpretations (Schott 184SM, Alpha Heritage, Avirex). Field jacket: M-41/M-43 (Buzz Rickson's BR15410), M-51, M-65 (1965; Alpha, Propper, Rothco, Aspesi Minifield, Buzz Rickson's), French M-47 (Coulange), Safari jacket (YSL 1968, Abercrombie); Fjällräven Greenland (1968) as interpretation. Deck jacket N-1 (1944): Buzz Rickson's, Real McCoy's, Pike Brothers. Souvenir jacket: Tailor Toyo (1965) originator, Sugar Cane, Wacko Maria; Yokosuka tradition note.

Biker jacket: archetypes Schott Perfecto 618/613 (1928, double rider), Lewis Leathers Lightning (1950s) and Bronx, Café racer jacket (Vanson Model A, Buco J-100 via Real McCoy's, Lewis Leathers Corsair), Langlitz Columbia; drop armoured textile riding gear (REV'IT!, Spidi, Merlin, BILT, Dainese, Alpinestars, Fuel) — covered by G1 motorcycle gear. New Waxed cotton jacket: Barbour Beaufort (1983), Bedale (1980), Border, Belstaff Trialmaster (1948) and Roadmaster, Barbour International (1936); versions by fabric (Sylkoil, thornproof); move Belstaff and Barbour Beaufort/Bedale models here. Quilted jacket: Husky (1965), Lavenham (1969), Barbour Liddesdale, Mackintosh; types diamond/onion quilt.

Casual jacket: blousons and leather jackets not elsewhere (Aspesi Dakar, Loro Piana Roadster, Pendleton 49er, Vanson Enfield); move Tang jacket to East Asian shelf; types suede, leather, cropped. Trucker jacket: Levi's Type I (1905) / Type II (1953) / Type III (1962, 557/70505) with LVC and Japanese repro versions (3sixteen, Warehouse, TCB), Lee 101J Riders and Storm Rider, Wrangler 124MJ; types denim/corduroy/sherpa-lined. Harrington: Baracuta G9 (1937) originator, G4; versions Fred Perry, Ben Sherman, Merc; link Mod/Skinhead scenes. Coach jacket: 1970s US sports origin; Supreme, Carhartt WIP Script, Kith, Noah, Dickies Oakport. Varsity: Golden Bear, Dehen, Ebbets Field, Aimé Leon Dore; types leather/wool sleeves. Track jacket: adidas Firebird and Beckenbauer, Sergio Tacchini Dallas (1980s), Fila Settanta/Terrinda, Ellesse, Kappa; link Casuals scene. Cut-off vest: battle vest/kutte; Levi's Type III cut-off base; link Metal and Crust punk scenes.

Mixed mode: tier for everyday shells/puffers (market-covering brands plus Which?/CR/OutdoorGearLab test winners), variety for icons. Shell jacket (absorb Mountain parka): archetypes TNF Mountain Jacket (1985), Arc'teryx Beta AR/Alpha SV, Patagonia Torrentshell, C.P. Company Goggle Jacket (1988), K-Way Le Vrai Claude (1965), Kleppermantel, Berghaus Mera Peak; cut cycling/sailing SKUs (Castelli, Musto, SLAM, Rapha, Vulpine, Proviz) to E2 note. Puffer jacket: TNF Nuptse (1992/1996 Retro), Patagonia Nano Puff (2010) and Down Sweater, Moncler Maya, Uniqlo Ultra Light Down (2009), Rab Microlight/Neutrino, Stone Island Crinkle Reps; trim Joutsen/Nobis/Norden. Fleece (merge pullover): Patagonia Synchilla Snap-T (1985), TNF Denali (1988), Polartec note; cut Columbia/L.L.Bean SKU lists to 1–2 each. Anorak: Fjällräven Anorak No. 8 (1974), Napapijri Skidoo (1990), K-Way, Nike ACG; types pullover/half-zip. Puffer vest: TNF Nuptse gilet, Patagonia, Moncler (trim to 2), Schott 204DV.

depts.note: Tailoring houses live in the brand register; cuts (Savile Row, Neapolitan, Ivy sack) are archetype families.

b.v: cloth (mill, Super number, weight) first; then canvas (full > half > fused) and hand work

s.brief: Business suit: archetypes Brooks Brothers No.1 Sack suit (1895/1901), Savile Row structured cut (Huntsman, Anderson & Sheppard drape), Neapolitan soft suit (Rubinacci, Kiton, Attolini), Dior Bar suit (1947), Chanel suit (1954), Armani deconstructed suit (1980), Zegna; types single/double breasted, two/three piece, skirt suit; move Zoot suit, Teddy Boy drape to style notes/scene; Zhongshan and charro to Traditional. Blazer: Ivy sack blazer (J.Press, Brooks), rowing/club blazer (Rowing Blazers, Drake's Games Blazer), navy blazer, Bandhgala to Traditional. Waistcoat: tailored, odd waistcoat, evening; drop Nehru/qurte to Traditional. Tuxedo: YSL Le Smoking (1966), dinner jacket (shawl/peak), white dinner jacket; versions. Morning dress & tailcoat: morning coat, evening tailcoat (white tie); Ede & Ravenscroft, Favourbrook, Moss Bros hire note.

Tie: archetypes repp stripe/regimental (Brooks reversed stripe), Hermès silk tie, kipper tie (Michael Fish 1966), knit tie, skinny tie (Mod), bolo tie (Western); types silk/wool/grenadine · width · seven-fold; makers Drake's, E. Marinella, Charvet, Ralph Lauren. Bow tie: self-tie/pre-tied, batwing/butterfly; bootlace (Teddy Boy). Pocket square: silk/linen/wool; Drake's, Rubinacci, Simonnot-Godard; fold types. Cummerbund: pleated, black-tie; link Tuxedo. Braces: Albert Thurston (1820), Trafalgar; button vs clip; link Skinhead scene. Collar stays: brass/plastic/magnetic; tier.

depts.note: Restraint: market-covering brands plus Which?/CHOICE/CR winners; a few historic archetypes.

b.v: Pima/Supima cotton, modal, merino, microfibre; seamless vs sewn
b.w: Main quality marker for underwear and socks.

s.brief: Dissolve 'Other underwear': bra models (Empreinte, Chantelle, Wacoal, Simone Pérèle, Cake Maternity) to Bra, Jockey/Munsingwear/Chesty Bond/Zimmerli to Men's underwear or Undershirt. Bra: types wired/wireless/T-shirt/push-up/strapless/sports/nursing; archetypes Maidenform (1922), Wonderbra (1964), Playtex Cross Your Heart; tier brands (M&S, Triumph, Chantelle, Wacoal, ThirdLove, Elomi). Men's underwear: Jockey Y-front (1934), Calvin Klein (1982) brief, Björn Borg, Uniqlo AIRism, Sunspel; types boxer/brief/trunk/boxer brief. Undershirt: A-shirt/vest, Chesty Bond (1938), Hanes, Zimmerli, Mey. Panties: types brief/bikini/thong/boyshort/high-leg. Period underwear: Thinx, Modibodi, Knix; absorbency types. Thermal base layer: Uniqlo Heattech (2003), Icebreaker, Smartwool, Damart, Stanfield's union suit (1898), Devold; merino vs synthetic. Shapewear: Spanx (2000), Skims, Maidenform; types. Corset: types underbust/overbust/waspie/waist trainer; Orchard Corset, What Katie Did, Dark Garden; fetish/latex note. Socks: Darn Tough, Smartwool, Falke, Bombas, Uniqlo, Pantherella, Burlington argyle; archetypes Red Heel monkey sock (Fox River), Wigwam; types crew/no-show/over-the-calf/toe/compression; keep hiking socks here (general). Tights & stockings: Wolford Neon 40 / Fatal, Falke Pure Matt, Pretty Polly, Aristoc; types denier, opaque, hold-ups, suspender; trim SKU list to one per brand. Leg warmers: tier; balletcore note.

Pure restraint. Pyjamas: types classic piped, shorty set, onesie, flannel; brands Derek Rose, Sleeper (keep Party Pyjamas as m), Eberjey, M&S, Uniqlo. Nightdress: nightshirt as type. Bathrobe: types towelling, waffle, silk kimono robe, hooded, shawl collar; brands tier. Baby sleeping bag: keep tag baby; Grobag archetype as range, Halo SleepSack; tog types.

Swimsuit: types one-piece, racing (Speedo LZR Racer 2008 as archetype, trim to LZR/Fastskin families), halter, cut-out; Eres (1968), Speedo, Arena, Seafolly, Hunza G. Bikini: Louis Réard (1946) origin; Eres, Hunza G, Triangl; types triangle/bandeau/high-waist/Brazilian. Swim trunks: Birdwell Beach Britches (1961) boardshort archetype, Quiksilver boardshorts, Orlebar Brown Bulldog (2007), Vilebrequin Moorea (1971), Speedo brief; types brief/trunk/boardshort/hybrid. Beach cover-up: kaftan, sarong wrap, towel poncho; Seafolly trim; move Dryrobe models to E2 (Changing robe moved).

depts.note: Hats are a collector area (variety); gloves, scarves, belts tier with a few icons.

b.v: fur felt (beaver > rabbit) > wool felt; straw grade (Montecristi fino, toquilla) · brim/crown measurements
b.w: Hatter community axis (Lock & Co, Optimo; to verify).

s.brief: Dissolve 'Other hats' (158 models) into named kinds. Cowboy hat: Stetson Boss of the Plains (1865), Open Road, Resistol, Akubra Cattleman/Snowy River, Greeley, Atwood; types crease (cattleman, pinch), X-grade felt. Panama: Montecristi/Cuenca toquilla tradition (UNESCO 2012); Lock & Co Rollable, Borsalino, Homero Ortega, Optimo. Fedora & trilby: Borsalino (1857), Stetson Stratoliner, Lock & Co, Akubra; types brim width, centre dent, teardrop; pork pie separate. Bowler: Lock & Co Coke (1849) originator; Christys'. Top hat: Lock, Christys'; silk plush vs melusine; opera hat type. Boater: Lock Classic Boater, Olney; straw sennit. Pork pie: 1920s–50s jazz, Rude boy/ska; Bailey, Brixton. Homburg: Lock Harrison, Borsalino. Beret: Laulhère (1840) Authentique/Basque/Che, Kangol (1938), Elósegui; link Beatnik. Bucket hat: Kangol Bermuda Casual (1990s), Stüssy, Irish walking hat; link Britpop/Madchester. Sun hat: Tilley T1 (1980), wide-brim, floppy, visor. Fur hat: ushanka, papakha, shtreimel (faith note) as types; types faux/real. Traditional, ceremonial & uniform headwear: keep k94's long list as types grouped by region/faith (fez, turban, kufi, songkok, kippah, zucchetto, salakot, conical hat, Glengarry, Balmoral, shako, kepi, peaked cap, student cap) with cross-links to Traditional dress shelves and F4; no models.

Baseball cap (absorb 'Other caps'): archetypes New Era 59FIFTY (1954) and 9FIFTY snapback, trucker hat (Von Dutch 2000s), dad hat/strapback, five-panel (Supreme), cycling cap (Rapha; note E2); types fitted/snapback/trucker/five-panel; move military/uniform caps to Traditional headwear types. Flat cap: Lock & Co Gill, Hanna Hats Donegal, Stetson Hatteras, Kangol 504 (1954); types ivy/newsboy/eight-panel. Beanie: Carhartt Watch Hat A18 (1987), Acne Pansy, Dickies; types cuffed/fisherman/chullo/rastacap. Balaclava: tier, cut Amazon noise to 3–5 brands (Smartwool, Buff, Icebreaker). Headband: tier, trim to 3 (Nike, Buff, Heat Holders). Headscarf: hijab types (shayla, al-amira, instant, underscarf, khimar), keffiyeh (Hirbawi, Hebron tradition), babushka/kerchief; brands Haute Hijab, Vela, dUCk, Buttonscarves.

Scarf: archetypes Burberry check cashmere scarf, Hermès carré (1937) silk scarf, Tootal scarf (Mod/Skinhead), Johnstons of Elgin, Acne Canada, football scarf; types silk/wool/cashmere · neckerchief/bandana. Glove: Dents (1777), Hestra (1936), Sermoneta, Mechanix (work, trim), Roeckl; types leather dress/wool knit/ski/driving; trim Hestra to 3. Mitten: Lovikka tradition (1892), Hestra Heli; Selbu mittens (Norway) tradition. Shawl: Kashmir pashmina/Kani tradition, Orenburg shawl, Manila shawl (mantón), netela (Ethiopia), dupatta cross-link; types. Arm warmer & sleeve: merge UV sleeves; types knit/compression (sport note).

Belt: archetypes Hermès H belt, Gucci GG/Double G, Western tooled belt, Anderson's woven, Levi's (trim SKU list to 2); types leather/woven/canvas D-ring/studded (punk). Belt buckle: Western trophy and rodeo buckles (Montana Silversmiths, Vogt), Tandy roller buckles; collector note. Detachable lining or hood: one entry; Barbour hoods/liners, Mackintosh.

depts.note: National dress as garment kinds; weaves and prints as named cloths; traditions register carries technique, region and authenticity.

b.v: handwoven (zari, silk) > power-loom · GI/certification marks (Silk Mark, Handloom Mark, Vlisco guarantee)
b.w: Main authenticity axis across saris, kente, batik and ikat.

s.brief: Sari: dedupe 'X'/'X sari'; regional weaves as types with tradition entries (Banarasi, Kanjivaram, Paithani, Patola, Pochampally, Jamdani, Chanderi, Maheshwari, Mangalgiri, Sambalpuri, Leheriya, Bandhani, Tangaliya, Uppada, Kasavu); move toub to African shelf; brands register (Nalli, Kanakavalli, Raw Mango, Sabyasachi, Taneira, Suta). Sari blouse & petticoat: types. Lehenga choli: Sabyasachi, Anita Dongre, Manish Malhotra; types ghagra, A-line, sharara. Shalwar kameez: remove ao dai, baju, puletasi; types Punjabi, Peshawari, Anarkali, churidar kurta, Pathani; Pakistani lawn houses (Khaadi, Gul Ahmed, Sana Safinaz) in register. Kurta: strip dashiki/barong/vyshyvanka/huipil; types regional (Lucknowi chikan, Hyderabadi, kalidar, angarkha, pheran). Sherwani & achkan: Manyavar, Tasva, Sabyasachi; types. Bandhgala & Nehru jacket: Raghavendra Rathore, Jodhpur suit. Dhoti: mundu, veshti, kasavu types; Ramraj. Dupatta: types by weave.

Kimono: keep formality types; traditions Nishijin-ori, Kyo-yuzen, Oshima tsumugi, Yuki tsumugi, Kaga-yuzen (Japan designated crafts); houses Chiso, Ginza Motoji. Yukata and Haori: fill with types and makers (Sou·Sou, Y. & Sons, Kyoto Kimono Yuzen). Hakama: cut Tozando/Seido SKU flood to kind-level types (aikido, kendo/iaido, formal striped sendaihira) with 3–5 makers. Obi (from Sash): maru, fukuro, nagoya, hanhaba types. Hanbok: jeogori/chima/baji/durumagi types; Leesle, Tchai Kim, Hanbok Lynn; Danha. Ruqun and Beizi: Hanfu makers (Shisanyu, Zhonglingji, Minghuatang, Chixia) with series as ranges; Mamianqun: horse-face skirt (Ming), Dior 2022 controversy note. Qipao: 1920s Shanghai; Shanghai Tang, Linva Tailor, Mee Wah; Suzhou/Hong Kong tailoring tradition. Zhongshan suit (1920s) and Tang jacket: Hongdu, Longqingxiang, Ruifuxiang; trim brand list to register.

Ao dai (Vietnam): types; Hue/Saigon ateliers. Baju kurung & baju Melayu: Malaysia/Brunei; Raya labels. Kebaya: Javanese, Peranakan nyonya, Balinese types; Anne Avantie; UNESCO 2024 listing. Sarong & wrap cloth: longyi, sinh, sampot, lavalava, kikoi, kitenge types with traditions. Barong Tagalog: piña/jusi; Heritage Barong, Kultura. Terno & Filipiniana: butterfly sleeve; Vinta Gallery. Pacific island dress: puletasi, mu'umu'u, robe mission, aloha-print sets; Pacific Sisters.

Thobe: regional types (Saudi, Emirati kandura, Kuwaiti dishdasha, Omani, Moroccan djellaba, Sudanese jalabiya, Algerian gandoura); brands Lomar, Toby, Shukr; trim. Abaya: types open/closed/bisht-style; manteau as Iranian type; Dubai and Riyadh designers in register. Kaftan: Moroccan caftan tradition, Algerian karakou/chedda/blouza as types, Western 1960s kaftan (Thea Porter); Camilla as interpretation. Wrap robe: chapan (Uzbek ikat, link Ikat cloth), deel (Mongolian), gho (Bhutan), bekasab; traditions.

Boubou & agbada: grand boubou, agbada, babban riga types; link to Named cloths (aso-oke). Dashiki: Angelina print (Vlisco 1960s) archetype; Africa Imports trim. Kaba and slit: Ghana; Christie Brown, Pistis. Habesha kemis: tilet embroidery; Shiro Meda weavers. Toub: Sudanese wrap; Sara Issa, Toob for Less. Herero and shweshwe dresses as types/notes where sourced.

Dirndl: cut 300+ brand list to register core (Lena Hoschek, Gottseidank, Sportalm, Lodenfrey, Krüger, MarJo, Angermaier, Stockerpoint, Tostmann); types Landhaus vs Tracht, length. Lederhosen: kurze/kniebund; Meindl, Spieth & Wensky. Trachtenjanker: Loden jacket; Schneiders, Giesswein. Kilt: Great Kilt vs modern, 8-yard, utility kilt; kiltmakers Kinloch Anderson, Lochcarron, Gordon Nicolson, Kinloch; trim 200-shop list to register stubs; tartan tradition link. Bunad: regional types; Husfliden. Traje de flamenca: SIMOF designers; types lunares, volantes. Vyshyvanka: regional embroidery; Vita Kin, Etnodim; Vyshyvanka Day. Gákti: Sámi tradition; duodji.

Poncho: traditional forms as types with traditions (ruana, sarape de Saltillo, jorongo, chamanto, poncho salteño, Otavalo, alpaca); rain and army ponchos as types; EcuaFina trim to 2. Huipil: Oaxaca/Chiapas/Guatemala weaving cooperatives (Jolom Mayaetik). Charro suit: traje de charro; Mariachi; makers. Guayabera: Cuban/Yucatán; Ramon Puig, Cubavera; pleat types. Bombachas & gaucho dress: Pampero, alpargatas note. Pollera: Bolivian/Peruvian cholita dress; Eliana Paco; Panamanian pollera type.

Cloth bought as lengths or pieces and later made up; each kind links a tradition entry (technique, centre, authenticity marks). Kente (Bonwire, Ewe), Wax print (Vlisco 1846, ABC Wax, Uniwax, GTP, Hitarget as Chinese copies; 6-yard piece), Batik (Javanese tulis/cap, UNESCO 2009; Danar Hadi, Batik Keris), Shweshwe (Da Gama Three Cats), Bogolan (Mali mud cloth), Adire & aso-oke (Yoruba), Ikat cloth (Margilan atlas/adras, Yodgorlik), Songket & tenun, Tartan (Scottish Register of Tartans; Lochcarron, Kinloch Anderson), Tweed (Harris Tweed Orb mark, Donegal), Khadi & handloom, Faso Dan Fani, Tapa/masi (Pacific).
